content.title: Twenty One Capital Debuts as a Bitcoin Play—and the Stock Drops 19%
content.summary: Twenty One Capital  became the stock market’s newest Bitcoin company Tuesday after completing a blank-check merger with Cantor Equity Partners.  It may take time for investors to warm up, CEO Jack Mallers told Barron’s.  Twenty One doesn’t look like most companies—even most crypto companies—that go public.
